children: Athletes from the University of Miami will be wearing Nike
gear for the next 10 years after the two sides signed a deal valued at ~$200M, according to sources cited by the Miami Herald.

deal with the Hurricanes translates into $20M per year, most of which will be in cash and the remainder in apparel and marketing elements, making it one of the most lucrative apparel deals in college sports.
The history between the University of Miami and Nike
goes all the way back to 1987, when Nike
became the first sportswear company to sign with a major university. In September 2015, Miami switched to adidas
in a $90M deal that expires June 2027. Adidas
was given until Tuesday to match Nike’s
bid. But despite making a "compelling" offer, the German sportswear giant couldn’t meet or match Nike’s more generous terms.
According to the Miami Herald, Nike
holds 27% of the global athletic footwear and apparel market compared to 13% for adidas
. With the return of the University of Miami, Nike
now holds the apparel contract with some of the top collegiate football programs, including Ohio State, University of Texas at Austin, Clemson, University of Michigan, University of Alabama, and LSU.

title: Nike reunites with the University of Miami with $200M deal - report
